from pathlib import Path
p=Path('fuzz-in/wasm/stuff.wasm')
data=bytearray(p.read_bytes())

idx=data.index(bytes.fromhex('41010b'))
data[idx:idx+3]=bytes.fromhex('410141020b')
# adjust section size for global section (+2 bytes)
# global section starts at byte 56? let's locate 06 section header and size byte
sec=data.index(bytes.fromhex('0606017f0041010b'))
print('global sec', sec)
# section header at sec: 06, size at sec+1 currently 06 -> 08
print(data[sec:sec+8].hex())
data[sec+1]=0x08
# shift following bytes already handled by replacement length increase
# data init expr multi-op too: i32.const 2; i32.const 3; end
idx=data.index(bytes.fromhex('41020b'))
data[idx:idx+3]=bytes.fromhex('410241030b')
# adjust data section size +2
sec=data.index(bytes.fromhex('0b0568656c6c6f'))
# data section header is 0b 0b 01 00 ...? find exact start by searching preceding bytes
for i in range(len(data)-10):
    if data[i]==0x0b and data[i+1]==0x0b and data[i+2]==0x01 and data[i+3]==0x00:
        sec=i
        break
print('data sec', sec)
print(data[sec:sec+12].hex())
data[sec+1]=0x0d
out=Path('/workspace/poc2.wasm')
out.write_bytes(data)
print('wrote', out, len(data))
